ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; predominantly low-intensity black pixels (>90%) with sparse high-intensity white linear and circular clusters (<10%) concentrated at tips and as surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the continuous fluke surface; high-contrast textured beige/white clusters located at the extreme distal tips (coordinates [0-50, 0-100] and [0-50, 900-1000] relative); scattered high-intensity linear marks distributed randomly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees; base of notch is distinctly pointed with minimal rounding.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge; distinct jagged peaks (3-5 pixels depth) observed primarily on the distal thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory from the median notch extending to a wide convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast, textured pixels at the far left and right tips, indicating heavy sessile organism colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast grey and white linear disruptions (rake marks) varying in length from 10-50 pixels, oriented primarily in a vertical or diagonal-downward direction across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal tips and prominent vertical rake marks across the ventral surface.
